text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day after Satono Diamond's first GⅠ victory, as we were walking through town—

text_block_list.name: Arcade Staff
text_block_list.text:
One free lottery ticket per person with a chance to win lavish prizes!
Satono Diamond's 'GⅠ Victory Commemoration Event'
is now underway!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Intrigued by the barker outside, I entered the arcade.
The shop was flashily decorated, with photo panels
from the other day's race plastered all over the place.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san.
Hello.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hello! Did you come to play
games too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: No, I was just surprised by Dia's event...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ask why an event for Satono Diamond is being held.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This arcade uses cabinets
developed by the Satono Group.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: To commemorate my GⅠ victory, we are holding an event at one of our group-affiliated facilities.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "When something joyous happens, we share the benefits with our customers and spread the happiness to everyone"—that is the policy of the Satono Group.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I was sure we had received
permission from the academy as well, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Most likely, since it was a matter outside of racing,
the academy took care of everything for us.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: We're heading to a family restaurant right now. Trainer, would you like to come with us?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're right! Please, let's do it together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yay! Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah... wait, before that.
Please give me just a moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Satono Diamond spoke to the shop staff and handed over an autograph board.
Next, she signed one of the arcade cabinets.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, she's going around to group-affiliated facilities
like this to sign autographs!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan thought it up all on her own, hoping it would bring even a little joy to the customers visiting the shop!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"They can't travel across the whole country, of course,
so instead, they're sending autograph boards stamped
with the horseshoes they used during GⅠ races!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Shall we get going, then?

text_block_list.name: Dia & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Three "Dia-Burgers," please!

text_block_list.name: Family Restaurant Waiter
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Please wait a moment.
choice_data_list: They even have an event-exclusive menu...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, to tell you the truth,
the "Dia-burg" is a recreation
of the hamburger steak my mother used to make.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...The day before I raced,
Mother would stand in the kitchen herself instead of the chef
and make Salisbury steak for me."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
On top of a slightly rounded hamburg steak, there was cheese cut into diamond shapes...
with a handmade flag placed right in the center.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how busy she was with work,
Mother would always make cheering hamburg steaks for me."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's why it's "Dia-berg"!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I doubt it'll taste entirely identical
to Mother's hamburger steak...
but I'm really looking forward to it too♪

text_block_list.name: Family Restaurant Waiter
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting.
Here is your "Dia-burg" steak.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yay, it's finally here!
Time to dig in!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: *Munch, munch*... Mmm!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This... tastes so much like Mother's cooking!
The way it crumbles softly in your mouth and everything...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu, I bet Mother
supervised it directly♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Dia-Burger" certainly felt
surprisingly homemade for family restaurant food.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Throwing such a huge celebration... Your mom and dad must've been over the moon about Dia-chan's first GⅠ victory, huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... They did congratulate me over the phone,
but it was pretty ordinary, you know? They seemed busy with work.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh, really?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Though they did say they'd celebrate for me
the next time I visit home."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Do both of you still have room
left in your stomachs?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Another cafe run by our group is also hosting a
one-coin cake set event to celebrate the GⅠ victory.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Let's have dessert over there♪
After that, all the indoor attractions will be
free of charge, so...
choice_data_list: Was it because Diamond's parents were so busy...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I think they were probably just busy preparing for the GⅠ Victory Celebration event.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Could every affiliated group facility
be hosting an event right now...?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, for today's reservations only, the Satono
Resort Hotel's accommodation fee is also
just one coin!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, please feel free
to use it as well, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It seriously feels like every single facility has something going on!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The scale of the celebration is on a whole different level.
It really drives home just how immense the joy of Satono Diamond's parents and clan truly is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Satono family's very first GⅠ victory.
The great feat achieved by Satono Diamond
brought immense joy to so many people.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Together with her, let's keep delivering
countless victories from now on――"
